items.claim_text: The taxi study's results have now been directly confirmed in restaurants nationwide: higher suggested tip rates on restaurant screens cause customers to leave more money, just as they did in the New York City taxi data.

C1.reason: The Ledger supports a causal effect only for NYC taxi passengers exposed to higher suggested defaults; it does not establish direct confirmation among restaurant customers nationwide, so the actor, setting, scope, and asserted confirmation exceed the Ledger.
